author: Zew
body:
@GrapeSmoothie

I understand where you're coming from, but all I did was say a first name, followed by an insult

I did not link it or make a reference to a player of whom may have had this name. 

I simply stated a name.

You claim i had leaked personal information when in reality if I had said 'John Idiot' and your name happened to be john - could you really claim i was leaking your 'personal information'? No.

I said Matias MORON -  and did not refer it to any specific player or say an IGN and therefore did not break this specific rule.

title: The warn about personal information

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
Hello Zew,

First off id like to correct you on my identity. My name is not John my name is Gregory but most people on Avicus call me Greg. Now for me to give an explanation on why you were warned for leaking someones personal information. I received a complaint about you and another user saying someones real name ingame and this user wasn't okay with it. Here on the Avicus Network releasing someones private information is strictly NOT allowed unless you have the consent of the user which consent was not given. In most situations this would result in an immediate permanent ban from the server but since there was no prior warning to not doing so you only received a warning. Regardless or not it was specifying which player, we must respect someones personal privacy. Once again you were not the only user punished for this.

Evidence: https://gyazo.com/a857cc34214e77e9d591246f7c6b99ea

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie :: Senior Moderator

replies.author: Zew
replies.body:
“First off id like to correct you on my identity. My name is not John my name is Gregory but most people on Avicus call me Greg.”

I never called you John, I simply used that as an example.

 

I don’t think you understand. All I said was a first name. If I said “Steve noob” in the chat, and someone in game whose name happened to be steve saw this, could they accuse me for leaking their personal information? That would be ridiculous. Since so many people have the same first name, you cannot call it personal information unless it was referred directly with a certain IGN.

The other user who said his name was at fault because he mentioned a first name AND a surname (If I’m not mistaken). The combination of both of these would count as personal information as it uniquely identifies an individual.

Please take your time when reading this instead of misunderstanding it and dismissing the reasoning.
